meta.name: amazon-competitor-analyzer
meta.description: Scrapes Amazon product data from ASINs using browseract.com automation API and performs surgical competitive analysis. Compares specifications, pricing, review quality, and visual strategies to identify competitor moats and vulnerabilities.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析亚马逊竞品的产品数据与策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在亚马逊上卖货，想了解对手的定价、评论和视觉策略。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Amazon competitor product data and strategies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you sell on Amazon and want to understand competitors' pricing, reviews, and visual strategies.

howto.what: 分析你提供的亚马逊商品ASIN，提取标题、价格、评分、评论数、图片，对比规格、价格、评论质量，找出竞争优势和弱点。
howto.when: 当你给出一个或多个亚马逊商品ASIN，要求进行竞争分析时触发。

say.text: 分析这三个耳机ASIN的竞争情况。
say.note: 会提取并对比它们的规格、价格和评论。
会输出价格区间和差异分析。

say.text: 找出这个ASIN的竞争对手弱点。
say.note: 会识别其劣势和市场机会。

howto.what_en: Extracts product title, price, rating, review count, images from Amazon ASINs you provide, compares specs, pricing, review quality, and identifies competitive advantages and vulnerabilities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide one or more Amazon ASINs and request competitive analysis.

say_en.text: Analyze the competition among these three headphone ASINs.
say_en.note: Extracts and compares specs, pricing, and reviews.

say_en.text: Compare pricing strategies for B09G9GB4MG and B07ABC11111.
say_en.note: Outputs price range and difference analysis.

say_en.text: Find weaknesses of this ASIN's competitors.
